name: Tsukishima Kaori
source:
Member of Dear, a popular idol group. Her singing abilities are widely acknowledged, but she doesn't particularly stand out in person, perhaps due to her reticent personality.

She doesn't fit in very well at school either, and spends a lot of time napping in the infirmary. Apparently, she can't sleep at all if she doesn't bring her own pajamas along.

Likes: Cowskin patterns, plushies her father gives her, singing
Dislikes: Carrots
Hobbies: Sleeping, skygazing, writing poetry
